scientific_integrity.claim_boundary: Exact quartic leading coefficient for each fixed period n>=5, and asymptotic-variance leading coefficient; no global epsilon formula.
scientific_integrity.computed_checks: Standalone exact rational character identities and nonlinear periodic-point diagnostics; numerical checks are nonexhaustive.
scientific_integrity.proof_method: Explicit smooth coordinate normalization; exact finite cyclic Fourier orthogonality; uniform transfer contraction and Green-Kubo correlation limit.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a specified smooth two-frequency family close to doubling, not arbitrary perturbations.
Fixed-period error constants can depend on period; a joint uniform estimate is not claimed.
Earlier unindexed perturbative calculations may contain an equivalent coefficient.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Quartic onset and finite-period exactness of Lyapunov variance near doubling
